title: RELAYTO AI's Alex Shevelenko on Eric's framing: ''Sounds good' are the two most dangerous words in entrepreneurship'
summary: Alex Shevelenko (CEO, RELAYTO AI) drops his Eric Ries interview — episode titled 'Surgically Deboned: How Modern Finance Kills Great Companies.' Eric on why evidence beats plausibility, why trust is underrated, and on the difference between ethos and integrity.
blockquote: Too many companies still run on opinions that "sound good." But as Eric puts it: "'Sounds good' are the two most dangerous words in entrepreneurship."
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on RELAYTO AI's Surgically Deboned podcast (via Gaurav S. on LinkedIn)
attribution_title: CEO of RELAYTO AI; host of the Surgically Deboned podcast
